title: Mobile (Solved for Equilibrium)
summary: A Calder mobile whose composition is not designed but forced by the law of the lever, thrown fresh per visit and never held still.
mechanism: Per-visit random binary tree of SVG rods whose pivots are placed by torque balance (order), swayed by a requestAnimationFrame damped-oscillator wind and pointer 'draft' (chance); prefers-reduced-motion freezes it into the print a mobile refuses to be.
